submission.justification: Mixture-G1 at 2.0 mm gas gap achieves the best possible time resolution of 0.885 ns, which is the primary project goal. This configuration was verified through comprehensive simulations across all three candidate mixtures and the full 1-3 mm gap range, with additional fine-tuning simulations at 1.5 mm and 2.5 mm confirming 2.0 mm as the optimal gas gap. Mixture-G1 delivers 46.5% better performance than Mixture-G2 (1.297 ns) and 119.6% better than Mixture-G3 (1.943 ns). A thorough review of all project documents found no environmental or safety restrictions on fluorinated gases, and the planned 90% gas recirculation system provides strong environmental mitigation for all mixtures. All technical requirements are met including HV system compatibility, production readiness, and supplier availability. This recommendation satisfies all constraints while achieving optimal detector performance.
